metadata.purpose: Curated descriptive + interpretive content for each cluster, surfaced in the Result page (single mode) and Cluster Dossier (batch mode). Tone: research-grade, factual + interpretive, no advisory recommendations. Each action signal links the cluster's data signature to a documented finding from the thesis or the matched-pair analysis.

Fragile Resigned.headline: Vulnerable, low-resource, accepting outlook.
Fragile Resigned.tagline: The most constrained Italian cluster across health, economic, digital and subjective dimensions.
action_signals: Lowest CASP-12 in the Italian segmentation (mean 27.8 vs 38.5 in Connected Active) combined with the highest forgone-care-for-cost prevalence — the cluster where affordability most constrains healthcare access.
Internet penetration 9% vs 64% in the matched-pair Swedish Fragile cluster: the +55pp digital reach gap is the single largest among the four matched pairs.
Welfare-state translation: structural beneficiary of universalist coverage. CASP gap with Swedish counterpart +5.7 points — the smallest among the four pairs, with the tightest confidence interval.

Fragile Depressed.headline: Subjective distress dominates the cluster signature.
Fragile Depressed.tagline: Health partially explains the pattern; subjective wellbeing collapses faster than objective vulnerability.
action_signals: EURO-D mean is the highest of the Italian segmentation; CASP-12 sits near 22 — substantially below the sample mean. Self-rated health is mid-range, so subjective distress is not fully explained by objective health.

Welfare-state translation: +9.6 CASP-12 gap with the Swedish Social Decline pair — the largest among the four matched pairs. Universalist welfare appears to compress subjective vulnerability where objective vulnerability is only partially equalised.
Forgone care for cost remains elevated relative to the Italian sample mean despite lower healthcare utilisation overall — financial constraint compounds the subjective burden.

Moderate Isolated.headline: Objectively healthy, structurally invisible.
Moderate Isolated.tagline: 27% of the Italian over-65 — the largest single segment that current healthcare access models do not capture.
action_signals: CASP-12 mean 36.8 and internet penetration 34% — objectively healthy and moderately connected. Yet preventive-dental utilisation is 27pp lower than the matched Traditional Social cluster (21% vs 48%), with 47% fewer specialist contacts.
The forgone-care-for-cost gap with Traditional Social is statistically zero — the access barrier is informational and relational, not financial. This rules out the standard affordability explanation.

Welfare-state translation: no analogue cluster in Sweden. Universal coverage redistributes this profile across other clusters — the Moderate Isolated phenomenon is a country-specific finding of the Italian segmentation.
Approximately 3.8M individuals nationally — the single largest segment whose service-utilisation pattern diverges from objective health status.

Traditional Social.headline: Strong social network, moderate digital reach.
Traditional Social.tagline: The only Italian cluster where the social-network and digital axes diverge meaningfully.
action_signals: Highest social network size in the segmentation (mean ≈ 3.8 confidants, top quartile) combined with moderate internet adoption — service access mediated through community channels rather than digital ones.

Healthcare utilisation pattern comparable to Connected Active (48% dentist visits in 12m, similar specialist contacts) despite markedly lower internet adoption — operational evidence that the digital channel is not a precondition for engagement with the system.

In Wave 9 the cluster partially compresses with Connected Active in the larger n = 2,378 sample (Robustness section): the traditional/digital separation observed in pre-COVID segmentation studies is dissolving in post-pandemic data.

Connected Active.headline: Top quartile on every measured dimension.
Connected Active.tagline: The structural ceiling of high-resource ageing in Italy.
action_signals: Top quartile on every objective and subjective indicator: highest CASP-12 (38.5), 75% internet penetration, social network ≥ 5, EURO-D under 2.
Highest household economic indicators in the Italian segmentation: median income €26,562 and median net worth €258,709 — the largest gap with the Fragile Resigned cluster on both dimensions.
Welfare-state translation: the smallest CASP gap with the Swedish counterpart (+4.3 points) — the saturated ceiling of welfare differential. High-resource ageing converges across the two regimes.

Fragile.headline: Vulnerable but digitally connected.
Fragile.tagline: Universalist welfare floor: even the most fragile cluster retains substantial digital reach.
action_signals: Direct analogue of the Italian Fragile Resigned cluster in the matched-pair design, but internet penetration 64% vs 9% in Italy — a +55pp gap directly attributable to universalist welfare and digital infrastructure.
CASP-12 mean 33.5 vs 27.8 in the Italian counterpart: +5.7 points despite both clusters representing the most vulnerable population in their respective regimes.
Forgone care for cost is markedly lower than in the Italian counterpart, isolating the regime contribution to the affordability dimension.

Social Decline.headline: Subjective decline in a high-floor regime.
Social Decline.tagline: The matched pair where the welfare differential is most visible.
action_signals: +9.6 CASP-12 gap with the Italian Fragile Depressed cluster — the largest welfare-state translation gap among the four matched pairs.
Internet penetration ≈ 36% (Wave 9 reading) vs 9% in the Italian counterpart — fragility does not collapse digital connection in the Swedish regime.

In Wave 9 the cluster does not separate cleanly at n = 1,787 (see Robustness section): it appears partially absorbed into Connected Wealthy, suggesting universalist welfare further homogenises the population.

Moderate.headline: Universalist mid-tier benchmark.
Moderate.tagline: The Swedish counterpart of Italian Traditional Social, with markedly higher digital reach.
action_signals: Internet penetration substantially higher than the Italian counterpart (60–94% across Wave 9 readings), driven by universal-coverage digital infrastructure rather than individual SES.
Healthcare utilisation pattern similar to higher-tier clusters — universal coverage uniforms preventive-care access across moderate-resource clusters.
Reference benchmark for the welfare-state advantage on the moderate-resource segment of the Italian over-65 population.

Asset Rich.headline: Country-specific to Sweden.
Asset Rich.tagline: Wealth concentrated in property and savings, with lower-than-average digital reach.
action_signals: No matched-pair analogue in the Italian segmentation. The cluster represents a structural feature of the Swedish housing-market and pension-system interaction.
Wealth-rich on property and financial assets but digitally below the Wealthy Digital cluster — a profile bifurcation that does not appear in the Italian k = 5 solution.

Wealthy Digital.headline: Sweden-specific digital-native ceiling.
Wealthy Digital.tagline: The structural top of the silver-economy distribution: high resources, high digital adoption.
action_signals: Above-average internet use, cognition, and quality of life — the structural top of the Swedish silver economy.
No matched-pair analogue in Italy: the cluster represents a separation between asset-rich and digital-native that does not surface in the Italian segmentation.

Connected Wealthy.headline: Saturated welfare ceiling.
Connected Wealthy.tagline: The Swedish analogue of Italian Connected Active — both populations reach a high quality-of-life ceiling.
action_signals: Top quartile across all objective dimensions, with internet penetration ≈ 99% vs 75% in the Italian counterpart.
Smallest welfare-gap pair: +4.3 CASP-12 points — the saturated ceiling. Both populations achieve high quality-of-life and the regime differential is minimal.
Operational reference for the upper bound of welfare-state translation: where both regimes converge.
